scope.closure_reason: User-authorized launch-quality remediation: replace answer-path leakage, repeated template analysis, missing metadata, untraced provenance, isolated-form drills, and weak writing ownership with evidence-bounded recognition, paragraph application, genuine sentence output, and conclusion transfer while preserving all eight IDs and the interaction sequence.

manual_quality_checks.authoritative_placement: Passed: prefix 1623 matches CET6 语法 / 虚拟语气 / 写作 and the catalog-owned eight-card count.
manual_quality_checks.independent_tasks: Passed: every front is independently answerable; the scoped audit reports no answer-path or analysis-conclusion leakage.
manual_quality_checks.independent_content_review: Passed after remediation: three independent read-only reviews found and closed internal scenario mirroring, an unsupported comparison baseline, a field-study/program referent mismatch, evidence-strength and English-naturalness issues, and a transfer task that had regressed to pure form recognition. Final replay found no residual P0, P1, or P2.
manual_quality_checks.writing_ownership: Passed: cards train evidence-bounded paragraph planning, conclusion selection, causal calibration, sentence elimination, two-sentence production, and whole-conclusion transfer rather than isolated grammar labeling.
manual_quality_checks.observation_and_sample_limits: Passed: 162301 owns a short observation-window limitation while 162306 owns an urban-sample output task; their scenarios and learner actions are no longer mirrors.
manual_quality_checks.causal_evidence_boundary: Passed: 162302, 162304, 162305, and 162308 preserve observations while treating missing controls, concurrent changes, retrospective reports, self-selection, and missing comparison groups as limits rather than proofs of effect or no effect.
manual_quality_checks.mixed_time_argument: Passed: 162303 consistently evaluates the program and links a past baseline-design gap to present evaluation ability without changing the claim.
manual_quality_checks.real_output: Passed: 162306 requires exactly two independently produced English sentences and preserves the four-campus, 800-student, 68-percent survey-report boundary without adding experience or causation.
manual_quality_checks.conclusion_transfer: Passed: 162307 presents four complete and grammatical continuations whose rhetorical moves differ; only the correct continuation keeps the current recommendation provisional and establishes a future revision trigger.
manual_quality_checks.integrated_transfer: Passed: 162308 selects a complete conclusion paragraph that preserves the observation, states two limitations, proposes a comparable future evaluation, and limits the current action recommendation.
manual_quality_checks.unique_answers: Passed: every multiple-choice item has one contextually and grammatically best answer; the elimination target is uniquely ①④.
manual_quality_checks.canonical_option_migration: Passed: type-8 cards 162303 and 162307 have canonical options matching form_options in text, order, and correctness, with synchronized answer_key values.
manual_quality_checks.interaction_parity: Passed: five multiple-choice answer_keys match sole correct options, elimination correct_items match exactly two target items, and flip cards remain unscored.
manual_quality_checks.metadata_enum: Passed: every weak_point_tag, difficulty, prototype, material type, review state, and progression role is schema-valid; 162301 explicitly justifies recognition-only advanced content in the foundation tier.
manual_quality_checks.adjacent_box_separation: Passed: 1623 owns writing-argument construction and output without duplicating 1621 reading inference or 1622 bilingual-equivalence/form encoding.
manual_quality_checks.source_and_audio_boundary: Passed: all examples are declared synthetic simulations, claim no true-exam provenance, contain no audio, and use audio_generation_method none.
